implementationAndSupervision: Codex (OpenAI), via Mingli Yuan; labels await Mingli review
encoding: 4 ternary head coordinates + 2 ternary zan-address coordinates; no dynamical or semantic isomorphism

labels.affirming: The selected passage and its explicit commentary support or commend the described disposition/action.
labels.adverse: The selected passage and commentary warn against, criticize, or describe failure of the disposition/action.
labels.qualified: A conditional or insufficiently explicit reading; a supervisor label, not the runtime Unknown status.

selection: First six source heads in order; sample first, middle, last zan; first three heads train, next three held out. Fixed before running predictions.
protocol: Train on 中 alone, then add 周 and 礥; evaluate the same nine held-out labels at each checkpoint. Held-out labels never enter the learning log. No hyperparameter selection on this holdout.
successCriteria: Every address round-trips and each retrieved text span reconstructs from the pinned snapshot
Source anomalies are explicit; no silent repair or invented commentary
Whole-head holdout has zero overlap with active supervision
Counterexamples refute coarse features and uncovered contexts remain Unknown
Conflicts, retractions, provenance checks, replay and fuel bounds remain available
Generalized engine agrees with frozen Zhouyi learner on declared regression queries
All existing changes-grammar source hashes and learning log bytes remain unchanged
nonclaims: Not a blind study: the supervisor can read the complete corpus; this is a small diagnostic pilot, not a semantic benchmark
No requirement that semantic transfer succeeds; report negative results and abstentions
No treating ternary digit 2 as Unknown
No claim of general classical-Chinese understanding, historical logic completeness or Adva six-germ equivalence
No implicit transition, calendar, divination procedure or automatic execution
